name: text-shine-sweep
title: Shine Sweep
description: Một dải sáng nghiêng 120° lướt qua các nét chữ hơi mờ rồi nghỉ, lặp lại vài giây một lần.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here
credit.upstream: after Magic UI (MIT); a faithful port is in the Magic UI collection

moworks.notes: Text at ~55 % (demo a dim grey gradient); a bright band (40–100 px; demo 30 % of the text width, clamped) at 120° crosses the letters (background-clip text): transparent → white → transparent (demo adds accent at 55 % on both flanks), from left of the text to past its right edge over 2 s cubic-bezier(.6,.6,0,1) (demo 0.4–2.4 s), then rests; loop 3.6 s (cycle 2–8 s). CSS version (6 s): sweeps right by 30 %, holds to 60 %, sweeps back by 90 %. Params: width: bề rộng dải (40–100 px) · angle (120°) · duration (2 s) · cycle: chu kỳ lặp (2–8 s) · ease (cubic-bezier(.6,.6,0,1)). The band is 30 % of the text's width, a background clipped to the letters.
moworks.titleVi: Dải sáng lướt qua chữ rồi nghỉ
